# Media fixtures

These binary fixtures are intentional and must not be hand-edited. The pre-existing
H.264/HEVC/MPEG-4 files in this directory are documented by `../manifest.json`.

The two files added by the MEDIA1 fixture work are:

- `av1_64x48_30fps_12.mkv` — AV1, yuv420p, 64x48, 30 fps, 12 frames, 1835 bytes;
- `vp9_64x48_30fps_12.webm` — VP9, yuv420p, 64x48, 30 fps, 12 frames, 1886 bytes.

They are generated by:

```powershell
python tools/fixtures/generate-image-format-fixtures.py --ffmpeg <path-to-ffmpeg>
```

The ffmpeg commands write `-fflags +bitexact -flags:v +bitexact` as output options, so the
files are byte-identical across runs with the same FFmpeg build; a different FFmpeg build may
produce different bytes. The current application rejects both codecs (see
`../images/formats/manifest.json` and `../images/formats/README.md`): AV1 reaches the
MediaProbe codec gate, while `.webm` is also outside the current video extension list.

All content is a synthetic `testsrc2` pattern; no third-party media is included.
